name: STRM DirectPlay
description: Control STRM file playback behavior and bypass transcoding for cloud streams
overview: STRM DirectPlay gives you full control over how Jellyfin handles .strm files. Perfect for users with self-hosted proxies, HLS streams, Alist, WebDAV, or cloud storage who want to minimize transcoding.

versions.changelog:
Initial release
- Multiple operation modes
- Domain whitelist support
- Block transcoding option
- Debug logging
- Security validation
